# json-c configuration passes detected conversion-function names to its header generator

The configure selectors prefer strtoll and strtoull when detected, then the Windows _strtoi64 and _strtoui64 alternatives. The in-tree json-c build reads those names from CONFIG and passes them as -Djson_c_strtoll and -Djson_c_strtoull when generating config.h. The selectors do not supply an additional fallback when neither probe succeeds.

Scope: build/json-c-conversion-aliases.
